en.setting: Oake Chemical Works sits in a brick compound beside the canal, its chimney releasing pale yellow smoke that drifts over the towpath. The mixing shed ventilation has not worked since March, and a thin yellow film covers everything in the workers' yard. An independent safety inspection was due on Monday.
en.crime: Frank Buckley, an independent safety inspector, was found in the canal below the works at dawn. His inspection case lay on the towpath beside his visitor badge, and a canal hook nearby matched the wound pattern.

suspects.name: Silas Oake
suspects.intro: Owner of the chemical works, whose scrubbed hands still carry a sulphur stain under the left thumbnail.

suspects.name: Mary Dunlop
suspects.intro: Mixing line worker who complained about fumes twice and whose pay was docked the week before.

suspects.name: Foreman Craggs
suspects.intro: Signed the daily safety log, his signature appearing on entries he claims not to have seen.

suspects.name: Dr Poole
suspects.intro: Conducted annual health checks but omitted symptoms of chronic sulphur exposure from his reports.

suspects.name: Ned Buckley
suspects.intro: The inspector's younger brother, employed at the loading wharf, who collected his pay that evening.

suspects.name: Mrs Oake
suspects.intro: Manages the works accounts and personally signed the denials on three workers' compensation claims.

suspects.name: Alderman Hicks
suspects.intro: Licensing committee member who deferred the works inspection twice, his campaign funded by the Oake family.

es.setting: La Fabrica Quimica Oake ocupa un recinto de ladrillo junto al canal, su chimenea liberando un humo amarillo palido que se desplaza sobre el camino de sirga. La ventilacion del cobertizo de mezclas no funciona desde marzo, y una fina pelicula amarilla cubre todo en el patio de los trabajadores. Una inspeccion de seguridad independiente estaba prevista para el lunes.
es.crime: Frank Buckley, un inspector de seguridad independiente, fue encontrado en el canal debajo de la fabrica al amanecer. Su maletin de inspeccion yacia en el camino de sirga junto a su credencial de visitante, y un gancho de canal cercano coincidia con el patron de la herida.

suspects.name: Silas Oake
suspects.intro: Propietario de la fabrica quimica, cuyas manos restregadas aun llevan una mancha de azufre bajo la una del pulgar izquierdo.

suspects.name: Mary Dunlop
suspects.intro: Trabajadora de la linea de mezcla que se quejo de los gases dos veces y cuyo salario fue recortado la semana anterior.

suspects.name: Capataz Craggs
suspects.intro: Firmo el registro diario de seguridad, su firma apareciendo en entradas que afirma no haber visto.

suspects.name: Dr Poole
suspects.intro: Realizo chequeos anuales de salud pero omitio sintomas de exposicion cronica al azufre en sus informes.

suspects.name: Ned Buckley
suspects.intro: El hermano menor del inspector, empleado en el muelle de carga, que cobro su salario esa noche.

suspects.name: Sra. Oake
suspects.intro: Gestiona las cuentas de la fabrica y firmo personalmente las denegaciones de tres reclamaciones de compensacion.

suspects.name: Concejal Hicks
suspects.intro: Miembro del comite de licencias que aplaz la inspeccion dos veces, su campana financiada por la familia Oake.

fr.setting: L'Usine Chimique Oake occupe un enclos de briques au bord du canal, sa cheminee liberant une fumee jaune pale qui derive sur le chemin de halage. La ventilation de l'atelier de melange ne fonctionne plus depuis mars, et un fin film jaune recouvre tout dans la cour des ouvriers. Une inspection de securite independante etait prevue pour lundi.
fr.crime: Frank Buckley, un inspecteur de securite independant, a ete retrouve dans le canal en contrebas de l'usine a l'aube. Sa mallette d'inspection reposait sur le chemin de halage a cote de son badge de visiteur, et un croc de canal a proximite correspondait au schema de la blessure.

suspects.name: Silas Oake
suspects.intro: Proprietaire de l'usine chimique, dont les mains lavees portent encore une tache de soufre sous l'ongle du pouce gauche.

suspects.name: Mary Dunlop
suspects.intro: Ouvriere de la ligne de melange qui s'est plainte des vapeurs deux fois et dont la paie a ete reduite la semaine precedente.

suspects.name: Contremaitre Craggs
suspects.intro: A signe le registre de securite quotidien, sa signature apparaissant sur des entrees qu'il pretend ne pas avoir vues.

suspects.name: Dr Poole
suspects.intro: A effectue les bilans de sante annuels mais a omis les symptomes d'exposition chronique au soufre dans ses rapports.

suspects.name: Ned Buckley
suspects.intro: Le frere cadet de l'inspecteur, employe au quai de chargement, qui a touche sa paie ce soir-la.

suspects.name: Mme Oake
suspects.intro: Gere les comptes de l'usine et a personnellement signe les refus de trois demandes d'indemnisation.

suspects.name: Echevin Hicks
suspects.intro: Membre du comite des licences qui a reporte l'inspection deux fois, sa campagne financee par la famille Oake.

physical_evidence.en: The canal hook by the towpath gate matched the wound pattern on Buckley's skull. The sulphur stain under Oake's left thumbnail would not wash clean. Buckley's inspection case lay open on the towpath beside his visitor badge, and the mixing shed ventilation had not worked since March.
physical_evidence.es: El gancho del canal junto a la puerta del camino de sirga coincidia con el patron de la herida en el craneo de Buckley. La mancha de azufre bajo la una del pulgar izquierdo de Oake no se limpiaba. El maletin de inspeccion de Buckley yacia abierto en el camino de sirga junto a su credencial de visitante, y la ventilacion del cobertizo de mezclas no funcionaba desde marzo.
physical_evidence.fr: Le croc du canal pres de la porte du halage correspondait au schema de la blessure sur le crane de Buckley. La tache de soufre sous l'ongle du pouce gauche d'Oake ne partait pas au lavage. La mallette d'inspection de Buckley reposait ouverte sur le chemin de halage a cote de son badge de visiteur, et la ventilation de l'atelier de melange ne fonctionnait plus depuis mars.

witness_testimony.en: The bargeman saw Oake at the towpath gate after shift end. The gatekeeper watched him walk toward the canal in the dark. Mary Dunlop complained about fumes twice and had her pay docked for it. Foreman Craggs signed safety entries he claims never to have seen.
witness_testimony.es: El barquero vio a Oake en la puerta del camino de sirga despues del fin del turno. El guardia lo vio caminar hacia el canal en la oscuridad. Mary Dunlop se quejo de los gases dos veces y le recortaron el salario por ello. El Capataz Craggs firmo registros de seguridad que afirma no haber visto.
witness_testimony.fr: Le batelier a vu Oake a la porte du halage apres la fin du quart. Le gardien l'a vu marcher vers le canal dans l'obscurite. Mary Dunlop s'est plainte des vapeurs deux fois et a vu sa paie reduite pour cela. Le Contremaitre Craggs a signe des registres de securite qu'il pretend ne pas avoir vus.

financial_trail.en: Three years of falsified safety logs kept the works open. The backdated ink did not match the quarterly entries. Mrs Oake personally signed the denials on three workers' compensation claims, and Alderman Hicks deferred the licensing inspection twice with campaign money from the Oake family.
financial_trail.es: Tres anos de registros de seguridad falsificados mantuvieron la fabrica abierta. La tinta antedatada no coincidia con las entradas trimestrales. La Sra. Oake firmo personalmente las denegaciones de tres reclamaciones de compensacion, y el Concejal Hicks aplazn la inspeccion de licencias dos veces con dinero de campana de la familia Oake.
financial_trail.fr: Trois ans de registres de securite falsifies ont maintenu l'usine ouverte. L'encre antidatee ne correspondait pas aux ecritures trimestrielles. Mme Oake a personnellement signe les refus de trois demandes d'indemnisation, et l'Echevin Hicks a reporte l'inspection des licences deux fois avec l'argent de campagne de la famille Oake.

emotional_tells.en: Oake scrubbed his hands but the sulphur stayed under his nail. Ned Buckley collected his brother's pay that evening and said nothing to the foreman. Dr Poole omitted symptoms of chronic sulphur exposure from his annual reports and would not meet the workers' eyes at the inquest.
emotional_tells.es: Oake se restreg las manos pero el azufre permanecio bajo su una. Ned Buckley cobro el salario de su hermano esa noche y no dijo nada al capataz. El Dr Poole omitio sintomas de exposicion cronica al azufre en sus informes anuales y no quiso mirar a los trabajadores a los ojos en la investigacion.
emotional_tells.fr: Oake s'est frotte les mains mais le soufre est reste sous son ongle. Ned Buckley a touche la paie de son frere ce soir-la et n'a rien dit au contremaitre. Le Dr Poole a omis les symptomes d'exposition chronique au soufre dans ses rapports annuels et n'a pas voulu croiser le regard des ouvriers a l'enquete.

cold_case_physical.en: The canal hook was rehung by the towpath gate without being tested. The mixing shed ventilation was never repaired. The thin yellow film covered everything in the workers' yard, and Buckley's inspection case was filed in a back room that smelled of sulphur and damp brick.
cold_case_physical.es: El gancho del canal fue colgado de nuevo en la puerta del camino de sirga sin ser examinado. La ventilacion del cobertizo de mezclas nunca fue reparada. La fina pelicula amarilla cubria todo en el patio de los trabajadores, y el maletin de inspeccion de Buckley fue archivado en un cuarto trasero que olia a azufre y ladrillo humedo.
cold_case_physical.fr: Le croc du canal a ete raccroche a la porte du halage sans etre teste. La ventilation de l'atelier de melange n'a jamais ete reparee. Le fin film jaune recouvrait tout dans la cour des ouvriers, et la mallette d'inspection de Buckley a ete rangee dans une arriere-salle qui sentait le soufre et la brique humide.

cold_case_financial.en: The safety logs were rebound with clean pages, and the quarterly audit was deferred again. The sulphur readings that would have closed the works were disposed of before the inquest. The Oake family chimney stood against the sky, and the workers kept coughing through every shift that followed.
cold_case_financial.es: Los registros de seguridad fueron reencuadernados con paginas limpias, y la auditoria trimestral fue aplazada de nuevo. Las lecturas de azufre que habrian cerrado la fabrica fueron eliminadas antes de la investigacion. La chimenea de la familia Oake se erguia contra el cielo, y los trabajadores siguieron tosiendo en cada turno que siguio.
cold_case_financial.fr: Les registres de securite ont ete relies avec des pages propres, et l'audit trimestriel a ete reporte a nouveau. Les releves de soufre qui auraient ferme l'usine ont ete elimines avant l'enquete. La cheminee de la famille Oake se dressait contre le ciel, et les ouvriers ont continue de tousser a chaque quart qui a suivi.

all_strong.en: Silas Oake walked the canal path after shift end, met Buckley in the dark, and struck him with the hook that hung by the towpath gate. Three years of falsified safety logs, the backdated ink, the missing pages, the sulphur readings that would have closed the works forever — all of it pointed to a man who killed to keep his chimney smoking. The bargeman saw him at the gate, the gatekeeper saw him walk toward the canal, and the hook carried his bruise pattern on its handle. The sulphur line ran straight from the mixing shed to the courtroom.
all_strong.es: Silas Oake camino por el sendero del canal despues del fin del turno, encontro a Buckley en la oscuridad, y lo golpeo con el gancho que colgaba junto a la puerta del camino de sirga. Tres anos de registros de seguridad falsificados, la tinta antedatada, las paginas faltantes, las lecturas de azufre que habrian cerrado la fabrica para siempre — todo senalaba a un hombre que mato para mantener su chimenea humeando. El barquero lo vio en la puerta, el guardia lo vio caminar hacia el canal, y el gancho llevaba su patron de contusion en el mango. La linea de azufre iba directa desde el cobertizo de mezclas hasta la sala del tribunal.
all_strong.fr: Silas Oake a emprunte le chemin de halage apres la fin du quart, a rencontre Buckley dans l'obscurite et l'a frappe avec le croc qui pendait pres de la porte du halage. Trois ans de registres de securite falsifies, l'encre antidatee, les pages manquantes, les releves de soufre qui auraient ferme l'usine a jamais — tout designait un homme qui a tue pour garder sa cheminee fumante. Le batelier l'a vu a la porte, le gardien l'a vu marcher vers le canal, et le croc portait son schema de contusion sur le manche. La ligne de soufre allait droit de l'atelier de melange a la salle d'audience.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Everyone along the canal knew Oake had reason to fear the inspector, and the yellow dust that covered the works covered his guilt in equal measure. But the safety logs were ambiguous, the ink analysis contested, and the canal hook could have been swung by any desperate hand. Oake was arrested on the strength of his name above the factory gate. The workers watched him go and said nothing, and the verdict carried the weight of a town's resentment more than a prosecutor's proof.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: Todos a lo largo del canal sabian que Oake tenia razones para temer al inspector, y el polvo amarillo que cubria la fabrica cubria su culpa en igual medida. Pero los registros de seguridad eran ambiguos, el analisis de tinta fue cuestionado, y el gancho del canal pudo haber sido blandido por cualquier mano desesperada. Oake fue arrestado por la fuerza de su nombre sobre la puerta de la fabrica. Los trabajadores lo vieron irse y no dijeron nada, y el veredicto llevo el peso del resentimiento de un pueblo mas que la prueba de un fiscal.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Tout le monde le long du canal savait qu'Oake avait des raisons de craindre l'inspecteur, et la poussiere jaune qui couvrait l'usine couvrait sa culpabilite en egale mesure. Mais les registres de securite etaient ambigus, l'analyse d'encre contestee, et le croc du canal aurait pu etre balance par n'importe quelle main desesperee. Oake a ete arrete sur la force de son nom au-dessus du portail de l'usine. Les ouvriers l'ont regarde partir sans rien dire, et le verdict portait le poids du ressentiment d'une ville plus que la preuve d'un procureur.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong man was charged, and Silas Oake reopened the works the following Monday without an inspection. The safety logs were rebound with clean pages, the sulphur readings disposed of, and Frank Buckley's draft report was removed from the records room before the inquest. The workers kept coughing, the chimney kept smoking, and the canal flowed on past the towpath where an inspector had died for nothing.
wrong_accusation.es: El hombre equivocado fue acusado, y Silas Oake reabrio la fabrica el lunes siguiente sin inspeccion. Los registros de seguridad fueron reencuadernados con paginas limpias, las lecturas de azufre eliminadas, y el borrador del informe de Frank Buckley fue retirado de la sala de archivos antes de la investigacion judicial. Los trabajadores siguieron tosiendo, la chimenea siguio humeando, y el canal siguio fluyendo junto al camino de sirga donde un inspector habia muerto por nada.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais homme a ete inculpe, et Silas Oake a rouvert l'usine le lundi suivant sans inspection. Les registres de securite ont ete relies avec des pages propres, les releves de soufre elimines, et le rapport preliminaire de Frank Buckley a ete retire de la salle des archives avant l'enquete. Les ouvriers ont continue de tousser, la cheminee de fumer, et le canal de couler le long du chemin de halage ou un inspecteur etait mort pour rien.

cold_case.en: The file on Frank Buckley was closed without a name. The canal gave up nothing else, the towpath was walked by barges and workers who kept their eyes ahead, and the quarterly audit was deferred again. The mixing shed ventilation was never repaired, the safety log continued in its new ink, and the Oake family chimney stood against the sky like an accusation that no one was willing to read. The sulphur settled on everything, and the truth settled with it.
cold_case.es: El expediente sobre Frank Buckley fue cerrado sin un nombre. El canal no entrego nada mas, el camino de sirga fue transitado por barcazas y trabajadores que mantenian la vista al frente, y la auditoria trimestral fue aplazada de nuevo. La ventilacion del cobertizo de mezclas nunca fue reparada, el registro de seguridad continuo con su nueva tinta, y la chimenea de la familia Oake se erguia contra el cielo como una acusacion que nadie estaba dispuesto a leer. El azufre se deposito sobre todo, y la verdad se deposito con el.
cold_case.fr: Le dossier sur Frank Buckley a ete clos sans un nom. Le canal n'a rien livre d'autre, le chemin de halage etait parcouru par des peniches et des ouvriers qui gardaient les yeux devant eux, et l'audit trimestriel a ete reporte a nouveau. La ventilation de l'atelier de melange n'a jamais ete reparee, le registre de securite a continue avec sa nouvelle encre, et la cheminee de la famille Oake se dressait contre le ciel comme une accusation que personne n'etait dispose a lire. Le soufre s'est depose sur tout, et la verite s'est deposee avec lui.

lucky_guess.en: Oake's name came up because his works stood over the canal and his gate faced the towpath. It was geography more than evidence. The sulphur stain under his nail, the gatekeeper's half-remembered sighting, the timing of the shift — none of it would have held alone, but stacked together it formed something that resembled a case. The jury smelled the sulphur and convicted on the fumes.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre de Oake surgio porque su fabrica se erguia sobre el canal y su puerta daba al camino de sirga. Era mas geografia que evidencia. La mancha de azufre bajo su una, el avistamiento a medias recordado del guardia, el momento del turno — nada de eso se habria sostenido solo, pero apilado formaba algo que se asemejaba a un caso. El jurado olio el azufre y condeno por los vapores.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom d'Oake est apparu parce que son usine surplombait le canal et que son portail faisait face au chemin de halage. C'etait de la geographie plus que des preuves. La tache de soufre sous son ongle, l'observation a demi retenue du gardien, le moment du quart — rien de tout cela n'aurait tenu seul, mais empile ensemble, cela formait quelque chose qui ressemblait a une affaire. Le jury a senti le soufre et a condamne sur les vapeurs.

expressions.suspect:silas_oake: Silas Oake stood in his office doorway with his coat already on. His hands were scrubbed but a sulphur stain remained under the left thumbnail.
expressions.event:canal_path: Frank Buckley was struck on the canal towpath and fell into the water. The canal hook found nearby matched the wound pattern.
expressions.motive:safety_falsification: The safety log had been rewritten to conceal three years of excessive fume readings. Buckley's inspection would have exposed every entry.
expressions.suspect:mary_dunlop: Mary Dunlop worked the mixing line and had complained about fumes twice. Her pay slip was docked the week before the inspection.
expressions.suspect:foreman_craggs: Foreman Craggs supervised the mixing shed and signed the daily safety log. His signature appeared on entries he claimed not to have seen.
expressions.suspect:dr_poole: Dr Poole conducted annual health checks for the works. His reports omitted symptoms consistent with chronic sulphur exposure.
expressions.suspect:ned_buckley: Ned Buckley was the inspector's younger brother and worked at the loading wharf. He collected his pay that evening and left by the canal path.
expressions.suspect:mrs_oake: Mrs Oake managed the works accounts from the house adjoining the office. She signed the compensation claim denials personally.
expressions.suspect:alderman_hicks: Alderman Hicks sat on the licensing committee and had deferred the works inspection twice. His election campaign received a donation from the Oake family.
expressions.location:oake_works: Oake Chemical Works occupies a brick compound beside the canal. The chimney releases a pale yellow smoke that drifts over the towpath.
expressions.location:canal_towpath: The canal towpath runs between the works wall and the water. At dusk the path is unlit and the canal surface reflects nothing.
expressions.location:mixing_shed: The mixing shed holds three vats and a ventilation hood that has not worked since March. The air carries a sharp metallic taste.
expressions.location:records_room: The records room is behind the foreman's station and holds safety logs dating to the opening of the works. One shelf is recently dusted.
expressions.location:loading_wharf: The loading wharf faces the canal and handles barrels of finished product. A visitor badge board hangs inside the gate.
expressions.location:oake_office: The office is on the upper floor overlooking the mixing shed and the canal. A safe in the corner holds the original safety certificates.
expressions.location:workers_yard: The workers' yard collects dust from the mixing process. A thin yellow film covers the bench and the water pump.
expressions.location:pump_house: The pump house draws canal water for the cooling system. The gauge readings are logged every four hours.
expressions.object:safety_log: The safety log shows daily fume readings within permitted limits for three years. The ink colour changes at the start of each quarter.
expressions.object:inspection_report: Buckley's draft inspection report was found in his case beside the canal. Three sections are marked for further action.
expressions.object:canal_hook: A canal hook was found on the towpath ten yards from the body. The tip had been cleaned but rust remained in the join.
expressions.object:workers_petition: A petition signed by fourteen workers requested an independent safety review. The petition was filed but never forwarded.
expressions.object:sulphur_sample: A sulphur sample from the mixing shed shows concentration levels above the permitted standard. The sample date is two days before the death.
expressions.object:gate_padlock: The works gate padlock was found locked at dawn. The mechanism had been freshly oiled and turned without resistance.
expressions.object:buckley_notebook: Buckley's inspection notebook was found with three pages torn from the spine. The remaining pages list fume readings that contradict the safety log.
expressions.object:pay_slip: Mary Dunlop's pay slip shows a deduction marked as absence. She was present on the day in question according to the clock card.
expressions.object:visitor_badge: Buckley's visitor badge was signed in at 16:20 and not signed out. The badge was found on the towpath beside his case.
expressions.object:acid_jar: An open acid jar sits on the mixing shed shelf with no cap. The contents have discoloured the wood beneath.
expressions.object:exposure_chart: The exposure chart on the pump house wall shows readings that exceed safe limits on eleven days in the past quarter.
expressions.object:compensation_claim: Three compensation claims were filed by workers reporting respiratory symptoms. All three were denied by Mrs Oake on behalf of the company.
expressions.object:lock_mechanism: The canal gate lock mechanism shows marks consistent with a key turned under pressure. The lock plate is bent inward.
expressions.emotion:blunt_authority: He answered without looking up from his ledger. His voice carried the flatness of a man who expects to be obeyed.
expressions.emotion:raw_grief: She pressed both hands against the mixing shed wall and did not speak for a full minute. Her breath came in shallow pulls.
expressions.emotion:measured_evasion: Every question about the safety log was redirected to the records room. He did not offer to retrieve the file himself.
expressions.emotion:closed_expression: The foreman stood with his arms crossed and his cap pulled low. He answered in single words and volunteered nothing.
expressions.emotion:sullen_compliance: She produced the accounts when asked and laid them on the desk without comment. Her hand shook only when she reached for the pen.
expressions.emotion:tight_jaw: His jaw tightened when the licensing committee was mentioned. He looked at the canal and then at the works chimney.
expressions.modifier:log_backdated: The safety log entries for March use ink from a batch manufactured in May. The discrepancy covers eleven days of readings.
expressions.modifier:padlock_oiled: The works gate padlock was oiled within the past twenty-four hours. The oil type matches the can in the foreman's station.
expressions.modifier:canal_drained: The canal level dropped six inches overnight after the lock was opened. The body settled against the far bank.
expressions.modifier:dust_settled: Yellow dust covers every surface in the workers' yard. The dust pattern shows a path cleared between the gate and the canal.
expressions.modifier:record_missing: Pages seven and eight of the safety log for March are missing. The binding stitches show they were removed after filing.
expressions.modifier:bruise_on_palm: A bruise on the right palm is consistent with gripping a hooked handle. The pattern matches the canal hook found on the towpath.
expressions.modifier:ink_changed: The ink in the safety log changes colour at the start of each quarter. The March entries use ink identical to the June supply.
expressions.modifier:boot_mud_pattern: Boot prints on the canal path show a size nine with a worn right heel. Ned Buckley wears size nine.
expressions.modifier:fume_reading: The pump house gauge shows fume levels three times the permitted standard. The reading was taken at 15:00 on the day of the death.
expressions.modifier:hook_cleaned: The canal hook tip was scrubbed but canal mud remains in the rivet join. The cleaning was recent and incomplete.
expressions.action:log_rewritten: The safety log was rewritten for March through May using backdated entries. The handwriting matches Oake's correspondence.
expressions.action:canal_walked: Oake walked the canal path after shift end on the evening of the death. The gate keeper saw him return at dusk with his coat damp.
expressions.action:gate_locked: The works gate was locked from inside at half past six. The key was found on the hook in Oake's office.
expressions.action:report_intercepted: Buckley's draft report was removed from the records room after his death. Only the copy in his case survived.
expressions.action:sample_disposed: A sulphur sample from the mixing shed was disposed of between the inspection and the inquest. The sample jar was found empty.
expressions.action:pay_collected: Ned Buckley collected his brother's personal effects from the works. He was given the visitor badge but not the notebook.
expressions.action:records_searched: The records room was searched after the death. One drawer was left partially open and the dust pattern on the shelf was disturbed.
expressions.action:claim_filed: A compensation claim was filed by the Buckley family after the death. Mrs Oake denied it citing insufficient evidence of workplace negligence.
expressions.action:notebook_torn: Three pages were torn from Buckley's notebook after the fume readings were recorded. The tear marks are consistent with haste.
expressions.time:shift_end: The evening shift ended at six. Workers left by the main gate and the canal path was the route to the village.
expressions.time:dusk_canal: Dusk fell at half past six and the canal path was dark within the quarter hour. No lamps are fitted between the works and the bridge.
expressions.time:dawn_found: The bargee's wife found the body at first light floating against the far bank. The canal lock had been opened during the night.
expressions.time:inspection_scheduled: Buckley's inspection was scheduled for the following Monday. His preliminary visit was on the afternoon of his death.
expressions.time:quarterly_audit: The quarterly safety audit was due at the end of the month. Buckley's report would have triggered an immediate closure order.
expressions.motive:exposure_prevention: If Buckley's report reached the inspectorate, the works would face immediate closure. The fines would exceed the value of the business.
expressions.motive:compensation_avoidance: Fourteen workers had filed or planned to file compensation claims. Acknowledgement of unsafe conditions would make every claim valid.
expressions.motive:licence_survival: The works licence depended on a clean safety record. Three years of falsified logs would result in criminal prosecution.
expressions.motive:family_business: The Oake family has operated the chemical works for two generations. Closure would end the family's income and standing in the town.
expressions.motive:political_protection: Alderman Hicks deferred the inspection twice at Oake's request. Exposure would end both their careers.
expressions.witness:canal_bargeman: The canal bargeman passed the works at half past five heading east. He saw Oake standing at the towpath gate.
expressions.witness:gate_keeper: The gate keeper locked the main entrance at six and saw Oake walk toward the canal. He did not see Oake return.
expressions.witness:night_stoker: The night stoker arrived at seven and found the mixing shed ventilation hood disconnected. He reported it to Craggs in the morning.
expressions.witness:works_clerk: The works clerk filed the safety log each Monday. She noticed the ink change but was told new supplies had arrived.
expressions.witness:bargee_wife: The bargee's wife found the body at dawn when she went to draw water. The canal level was lower than the previous evening.
expressions.event:frank_buckley_discovered: Frank Buckley was found in the canal below the works at dawn. His inspection case was on the towpath and his badge lay beside it.
expressions.event:quarterly_inspection: The quarterly inspection was commissioned by the county after worker complaints. Buckley was assigned as the independent inspector.
